change: Replace the separate 8192x1024 QKVZ and 32x1024 BA projections in each of 18 GDN layers with one 8224x1024 MergedColumnParallelLinear call.
reason: The legal launch-reduction rewrite was 5.7% slower in TPOT and 6.9% slower end-to-end in the cheap screen. The likely explanation is that changing the large projection output from the tile-friendly 8192 rows to 8224 harms the selected GEMV schedule more than removing the tiny 32-row BA launch saves; this causal explanation remains an inference until kernel-level profiling.
limitations: Power and clocks were observed neither locked nor recorded in this cheap screen.
Each side used one timed trial after one workload warmup.
Runtime kernel-count proof has not yet been bound, so this record is not a formal candidate-smoke-result-v3 or qualification result.
